definitions.gloss: front side; outer surface; right side (of fabric)
definitions.explanation: the side of an object meant to face outward or be seen, as opposed to the back or hidden side

examples.japanese: {表側|おもてがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look at the front side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表側|おもてがわ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えないで→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧。
examples.english: Don't mix up the right side and wrong side of the fabric.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表側|おもてがわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大通|おおどお}り→大通り：26913_oodoori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}していて→面する：14629_mensuru⟧、⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The front of this building faces the main street, and there's a parking lot at the back.

notes:
Combines ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧ (front, surface) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Contrasts with ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧ (back side, reverse side). Used for fabrics, buildings, coins, paper, and any object with a distinct front and back.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表側|おもてがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧: to print on the front side
- {表側|おもてがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to place face up
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表側|おもてがわ}: the front of a building
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表側|おもてがわ}: the right side of fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: surface — refers to the physical outer surface of an object, not specifically the front
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧: front face — the side directly facing the viewer
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧: back side; reverse side — the antonym of {表側|おもてがわ}
